components.name: Contextual rail specimen
components.description: Classical ribbon rendering only. Current routing at fixed 85% spacing: straight aligned rails, genuine switches with alpha clearance, outside legs branching from available incoming rails, and square end caps. Creator glyph acceptance remains open.

components.description: Native explorer for nine historical hands, including Ridge Alphabet and Harbor Blocks. The app synchronizes the stage selector and aria-pressed nodes; Use this hand applies the selection. Solid descent and graphic borrowing remain distinct.
components.html:
Classical

The original script · 0 to 300

Formal pen writing and teaching copies

What changes
Straight rails join across letters; genuine rail changes receive a flowing S-curve.
Why it changes
A school standard regularizes the hand without erasing outside legs or internal returns.
What survives
The current original rendering is preserved exactly; reconstructed curves remain open to the creator’s refinement.

components.name: Independent sound palette
components.description: Ridge Alphabet and Harbor Blocks use one full sound form per consonant or vowel button, each in a tight 44 × 44 SVG viewBox. Existing palette grids, IPA/key labels, hover and focus treatment remain; vowel buttons no longer pair diacritic and initial forms.

components.name: Harbor pictogram specimen
components.description: Signs 88 units tall use reduced one-shape components derived from the 31 Alphabet sound forms (each consonant keeps its stem stroke; a detached second stroke is dropped or joined) at .78 scale in onset/nucleus/coda rows with no enclosing chamber. Corners are softened into arcs. Components fuse by contact: row neighbours overlap 2 units, strokes running parallel between rows merge into one shared stroke, rows nest at most 12 units, and, only between components that do not already touch, short curved ligatures continue free stroke ends into neighbouring components without crossing other strokes. Each syllable is one outline-union pictogram: strokes at 8.4 units masked by the same geometry at 3.6 units. Each row reads left to right with unchanged orientation; capacity is 3C/2V/3C. Empty onsets/codas stay blank; a small crossed empty nucleus supplies no vowel. Overcapacity uses bracketed .8-scale alphabetic tiles. Eight prosody slots sit to the right in two columns of four, primary stress above; excess marks continue in bounded tiles.

narrative.overview:
The compact shell puts writing and preview directly below the header. There is no hero, repeated footer, output count, or specimen note. Short Save/Open and SVG/PNG actions keep the workspace concise. Grouped alphabet tabs and two collapsed disclosures provide explanation and appearance controls when needed.

The implementation in `src/style.css`, `src/index.html`, `src/app.js`, `src/phonetics.js`, `src/evolution.js`, and `src/descendants.js` is the authority. Earlier Classical desktop and 375px screenshots in `.impeccable/review/` show the paired Vowels palette and repaired initial outlines; `marks.jpg` records the approved prosody palette. Browser checks exercised keyboard tab selection, IPA and mark insertion, Appearance controls, and transparent PNG export; mobile client and scroll widths were both 375px. Classical source tests cover the shared preview/export outlines, 11 paired vowel buttons with 22 SVGs, approved prosody, and the schwa alias. Technical checks remain separate from creator acceptance of precise reconstructed curves.

Refreshed `evolution-desktop.jpg`, `evolution-mobile.jpg`, `evolution-editor.jpg`, and `evolution-mobile-tree.jpg` in `.impeccable/review/` record the history extension. The 390 × 844px `evolution-mobile-viewport.jpg` and browser checks confirm the intro remains visible on reopening, the stage heading precedes branch/date metadata, and the modal has no horizontal overflow (337px client and scroll widths). Opening returns to scroll position 0 with focus on Close. These checks establish interaction and layout behavior, not acceptance of the provisional genealogy or every allograph.

The nine-hand extension keeps the same workbench while introducing Ridge Alphabet and Harbor Blocks as structural descendants. `structural-alphabet-desktop.jpg`, `structural-harbor-desktop.jpg`, and `structural-harbor-mobile.jpg` in `.impeccable/review/` show independent sound previews and mode-specific artwork. `harbor-diagnostics.png` records onset/coda forms, all vowel components, ordered vowel pairs, empty positions, prosody, and bracketed overflow. These captures document the implemented structure, not a complete orthography or accepted historical reconstruction.
dos: Do keep the main writing flow compact and place extended explanations in the existing disclosures.
Do retain typing keys when displayed IPA differs, and keep candidate additions distinct from implemented mappings.
Do reuse local font stacks, selected-tab states, focus outlines, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep original photographs at their aspect ratios and preserve the original Classical glyph geometry.
donts: Don't treat phonetic presentation groups as changes to transliteration keys or pronunciation rules.
Don't describe browser checks as creator acceptance of every reconstructed curve.
Don't require external fonts or icon packages for the standalone editor.
